_comment: Bean vjbl: a BLIND second annotation of crdm-detect-corpus.json, 2026-09-24. The annotator was a fresh agent handed only the packet from `eval-crdm-detect-blind.ts pack`: opaque ids, title and text, and crdm-detect.md with the paragraphs naming corpus issues removed. Items are re-keyed here by issue number, so this file joins the corpus without the private key. Agreement with the first labels: 23/27, Cohen's kappa 0.62. Adjudicating the four disagreements (#27, #187, #222, #223) is the owner's.
